name: scenario_planning
description: Scenario-based financial planning and P&L impact analysis. Helps FP&A teams answer "what if?" questions by finding similar historical scenarios, adjusting assumptions, and showing downstream P&L impact. Also projects revenue from leading drivers and decomposes P&L movements into root cause drivers. Triggers: what if, scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, what would happen, P&L impact, why did margin change, what is driving revenue, root cause, decompose, adjust assumptions, model a scenario, driver-based forecast, lead-lag, low base high case.
